import { Event, MouseEvent, trace } from '../shim';
import { EventWatcher } from './EventWatcher';

export class RightButton extends EventWatcher {
  public constructor() {
    super();
    this.clicked = this.clicked.bind(this);
    this.frame1 = this.frame1.bind(this);
    this.frame2 = this.frame2.bind(this);
    this.addFrameScript(0,this.frame1,1,this.frame2);
    this.addEventListener(MouseEvent.CLICK,this.clicked);
    this.stop();
  }

  public clicked(event: Event): void {
    trace("///(RightButton clicked...)");
    trace("///this.gotoAndPlay(1);");
    this.gotoAndPlay(1);
    trace("///this.parent.l_button.gotoAndPlay(2);");
    (this.parent as any).l_button.gotoAndPlay(2);
  }

  frame1(): void {
    trace("///RightButton Frame 1");
  }

  frame2(): void {
    trace("///RightButton Frame 2");
  }
}
